description: The PKCE flow is downgraded from S256 to plain and the callback's code_verifier hash comparison is removed, so an attacker who intercepts the authorization code plus an observed verifier can complete the OAuth flow.
storedChallenge is module-level mutable state shared across all requests, so concurrent OAuth flows overwrite each other's PKCE challenge — a multi-tenant correctness/race bug.
timingSafeEqual is imported but no longer used after the verifier comparison was removed — a dead import that is also a tell-tale of the dropped security check.
